title: FBI-UAP-D015, Digital Rendering, Narrative Statement 1-2, Western United States Event, 2023

pages.description: A twilight desert landscape showing a straight gravel or dirt road receding toward a gap between two dark silhouetted hills in the center distance. The road surface reflects a faint light and narrows to a vanishing point at the horizon where a band of pale yellow-orange glow marks the sky above the hills. Flanking the road are scrubby desert vegetation, low bushes, grasses, and a yucca or agave plant in the left foreground. The sky is deep blue with a scattering of small star-like specks and hazy lighter clouds. In the upper-left portion of the sky floats a small round orange-red glowing object with mottled texture, accompanied to its left by three smaller red dots arranged vertically. No people or vehicles are visible.

observations.claim: A dirt/gravel road runs from the foreground to a gap between two hills in the distance
Two dark silhouetted hills or mountains flank the center horizon
A small orange-red glowing round object appears in the upper-left sky
Three small red dots are arranged vertically to the left of the orange object
The sky shows a yellow-orange glow near the horizon indicating dusk or dawn
Desert scrub vegetation and a yucca/agave plant are visible in the foreground
Small star-like specks are scattered across the darker upper sky
